title: GROUP command: current_article_number set to low even when count=0
description: In lifecycle.rs handle_group_live() (line 1415): ctx.current_article_number = if count > 0 { Some(low) } else { None }. When count == 0 (no articles in the group), the RFC 3977 sentinel is (low=1, high=0), so low=1 and high=0 but count=0. None is correctly assigned. However, the count calculation on line 1413 is: let count = if low <= high { high - low + 1 } else { 0 }. When the store returns (low > high), count=0 and handle_group_live returns 411 (line 1410-1412). So count is only used on line 1413 and 1415 for a group that IS carried (low <= high). If an empty-but-carried group has low=1, high=0, group_range returns (1, 0) — but the low > high check on line 1410 returns 411 (no such newsgroup), which is correct for empty groups. This logic is consistent. Not a bug.
